value.rationale: Determines the full sharp spatial numerical radius (not merely a bound or plateau) of the simplest one-site compact diagonal perturbations in both orientations on infinite-dimensional non-Hilbert ℓp. Identifies the exact reversed orientation-sensitive critical strengths, rigorous unique geometric norming vectors, and a common precise quadratic onset despite unequal thresholds, with a fixed essential disk. These resolve a motivated boundary perturbation threshold and norm-attainment classification in the contemporary Banach numerical-range setting.
